description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for ctrl-alt-defeat — Godot 4 card game prototype (15 files)

rules.name: Hardcoded enemy data instead of Resource
rules.message: Enemy stats hardcoded in script — use Resource files for data-driven design and easy expansion
rules.suggestion: Create EnemyStats resource (.tres) files: var stats: EnemyStats = preload('res://resources/enemies/goblin.tres')

rules.name: Combat end signal without reward handler connection
rules.message: combat_end signal has no reward handler — victories give no loot, XP, or currency
rules.suggestion: Connect combat_end to a reward handler: combat_end.connect(_on_combat_end_rewards)

rules.name: Card array with fewer than 20 entries
rules.message: Card database has fewer than 20 cards — insufficient for gameplay testing
rules.suggestion: Add more card definitions as Resource files; minimum 20 unique cards before testing

rules.name: Prototype stub without sprint tracking
rules.message: Prototype/stub code without TODO or sprint reference — will be forgotten and ship as-is
rules.suggestion: Add TODO(Sprint-7): or FIXME(#123) to track when prototype code should be replaced

rules.name: Direct scene change without SceneManager
rules.message: Direct get_tree().change_scene() call without SceneManager autoload — no progression tracking
rules.suggestion: Create SceneManager autoload with transition management and progression state
